questions.text: What is in scope for this change?

options.label: Named files only (Recommended)
options.description: Edit only the paths already named in the request.

options.label: Whole component
options.description: Touch every file in the named component.

options.label: Whole repository
options.description: Allow cross-cutting edits across the workspace.

questions.rationale: Scope changes correctness and blast radius.

questions.text: Which of these risk controls apply?

options.label: Dry-run first (Recommended)
options.description: Inspect and report; mutate nothing yet.

options.label: Write local files
options.description: Allow workspace writes after answers land.

options.label: Network allowed
options.description: Permit explicit outbound fetches with TLS.

questions.rationale: Risk posture is optional once a safe default exists.

options.label: Proceed (Recommended)
options.description: Apply answers and begin the task.

questions.rationale: Confirms the user wants work to start.
